COMMAND.card: The bridge and the command spine. Warden parties are cutting towards them from the forward locks. Bridge crew are holding the doors.

HABITATS.card: The habitats have fallen. The Wardens are taking their Tithe.

REACTOR.card: The main reactor, aft on the open spine. Engineering holds the access tunnel. No enemy contact yet.

FABRICATION.card: The printers and stores in the keel pod, next to the hangar. Quartermaster's crew report no contact.
